Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Modern Oak Dining Table, 63"L, Walnut Finish
Colors: Walnut
Materials: Oak
This table is beautiful in its design and simplicity. Solid oak legs have the slanted tapering reminiscent of mid-century style. You'll enjoy serving dinner to your friends, but it's also useful for crafting or working on your laptop. 63"L x 35.5''D x 29.5''H A clean, simple design that works well for any style home Assemble in 15-30 minutes. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty. Solid oak legs; hardwood top with oak finish
